_doc: KiwiSpec's auxiliary devices served as Alpaca devices by robofast_core.devices.kiwispec_aux_server (docs/kiwispec_aux.md). Each port is a serial-to-TCP bridge on the spectrograph PC (RFC 2217); the host and ports here are placeholders until the bridge is deployed.
name: kiwispec

stage._doc: The iodine cell selector: a Thorlabs stage on an APT stepper controller (legacy HWTYPE 12, BSC101; USB FTDI 0403:FAF0): 115200 8N1, RTS/CTS. It moves the iodine cell into (in) and out of (out) the light path, and carries the slit-flat lamp (flat), which is dead: listed, but disabled. Positions are the live spectrograph_server.ini's [I2POSITIONS] (in 11, flat 68, out 102 mm). counts_per_mm must be confirmed on the hardware before any move (null: positions and moves are refused).

backlight._doc: The fiber backlight (fiber back-illuminator for the guiders' fiber-position finding; served as a Switch: arm, LED, both). LED controller (legacy backlight: 9600 8N1, n8/f8) and Dynamixel XM servo (legacy: protocol 2.0, ID 1, 57600). The LED lights only with the arm in; it is turned off, and the arm swung out, max_on s after it was turned on.

telemetry._doc: Read only. The vacuum gauge controller (legacy gaugeController: 19200 8N1, '#  RDCG1' pump line, '#  RDCG2' spectrograph) and the Oasis chiller (legacy chiller.py: 9600 8N1, CR LF). robofast never controls the pump, the valves or their outlets.
